newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks surge 4.35 percent at close.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks surge 4.35 percent at close.

text.p: Pakistani stocks surged 4.35 percent at Thursday's close on a technical rally and genuine buying of select blue chips and dealers said they expected the index to remain firm in the near term.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 59.96 points, to end at 1,438.31. Gainers led losers 199 to 73.

"The market was terribly short and there has been heavy covering of positions," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "There is also some genuine buying interest in blue chips like PSO, Hub Power and Fauji Fertilizer." PSO rose 11 rupees to 338 and Hub Power 0.70 to 32.70. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
